# Local vendor worktrees

This directory is deliberately ignored except for this note. It is for local
source checkouts that support the setup but are not part of the dotfiles
payload.

- `sketchybar-system-stats/` is an optional local build of `stats_provider`.
- `macos-dotfiles-reference/` is an upstream design reference.

Clone or remove either worktree as needed; neither is installed by `./install`.
